description: This file implements CSV serialization and deserialization functionalities for the ADODB database abstraction layer, specifically providing methods to serialize recordsets into CSV format and restore recordsets from CSV files or URLs, including handling of special metadata and cache formats.

classes.name: ADOFieldObject
classes.description: A class representing a database field's metadata, including its name, type, and maximum length.

methods.name: _rs2serialize
methods.description: Converts a recordset into a special CSV serialization format, including metadata and handling different data provider types.

methods.name: csv2rs
methods.description: Reads a CSV file or URL and converts it into an ADODB recordset object, handling various cache and serialization formats.

methods.name: adodb_write_file
methods.description: Safely writes contents to a file with locking and optional debug output, handling Windows and Unix-like systems.
